notes.title: R1.5 - No More cozy Mode
notes.content:
There were some flaws, so I've regressed and changed the build to R1.5.

Please let me know if you continue to experience the bar glitch or any others, and I will get to fixing it immediately!

notes.title: R1.4 - Cozy Mode!
notes.content:
Cozy Mode is a mode in its first iteration currently, inspired by the lovely people over at the Cozy Gamer Discord! The full edit list is in the game itself.

Enjoy!

notes.title: R1.3 Update
